statements.impact_statement: picomatch is a development dependency only (through eslint-config-phun-ky) and is not a dependency of the published package. In development, the ReDoS is reached only by this repository's own lint glob patterns, never by input.

katex is a development dependency only (eslint-config-phun-ky > @eslint/markdown > micromark-extension-math > katex) and is not a dependency of the published package. In development, linting parses Markdown and never renders math.

basic-ftp is a development dependency only (release-it > proxy-agent > pac-proxy-agent > get-uri > basic-ftp) and is not a dependency of the published package. In development, it is reached only when a proxy auto-config file is fetched over ftp://, which releases never do.
